Relief shown by hachures. Cadastral map showing land grants and major landholders. Includes inset of "Map of Salinas City" 1:4,800 and advertisements. Scale ca. 1:125,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy annotated in blue pencil and red ink. AACR2: 651/1; 650/2; 650/3; 650/4; 651/5
